title: Automated full-process pipeline via multiparametric MRI for tumor segmentation, molecular subtype classification and prognostic factor analysis in breast cancer.
summary: A multiparametric MRI pipeline combined 3D U-Net tumor segmentation with 2D ResNet biomarker classification in 484 breast-cancer patients across three institutions; the study reports validation including external performance measures. This is retrospective image-analysis validation, not prospective clinical benefit.
ai_technology: A 3D U-Net segments tumors from multiparametric MRI, and a 2D ResNet classifies molecular biomarkers from the resulting image features.
organization: Department of Radiology, Tongji Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China

evidence.tested: Europe PMC abstract reports 484 patients at three institutions and validation with AUC/Dice measures; the exact metric values are omitted here.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical utility and treatment benefit were not evaluated; the reported external validation remains retrospective
evidence.ai_role: A 3D U-Net segments tumors from multiparametric MRI, and a 2D ResNet classifies molecular biomarkers from the resulting image features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
